senses.gloss: m. (קְדַח) borer (of pearls); trnsf. one able to enter into the depth of a Biblical subject.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:10:2">Cant. R. to I, 10</cite> <he>אנא הוינא חרוזא</he> … <he>ק׳</he> I am a stringer of pearls and I am also a borer, v. <cite ref="H01647"><he>חֲרַז</he></cite>.
